Explanation: The Product Listing is the Core Value Unit: a Merchant's product offer that can be searched, recommended, featured in short-form content or presented in a livestream and ultimately purchased through Taobao.

Taobao owns the consumer marketplace interface and top-level traffic funnel inside Alibaba's China e-commerce ecosystem. It coordinates search, recommendation, content, Merchant tools and transaction infrastructure.
Taobao must make enormous Merchant supply discoverable and engaging enough to convert consumer attention into transactions.
More consumer engagement and Merchant competition can increase transaction activity and demand for customer-management, marketing and software services.
Taobao must control low-quality supply, misleading content, fraud and advertising overload while keeping discovery useful rather than exhausting.
Taobao organizes product discovery, content distribution, ordering and the platform transaction around Merchant supply.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Order / Pay — Shoppers place orders and complete payment through Taobao's commerce flow. | → Consumer · Discovery / Trust — Taobao provides search, recommendations, content surfaces, transaction coordination and marketplace trust mechanisms. | ← Provider · Listing / Fees — Merchants contribute product listings and purchase applicable marketing, software or other marketplace services. | → Provider · Traffic / Payout — Taobao directs consumer traffic to Merchant supply and coordinates order proceeds through the platform transaction. | → Partner · Live Tools / Reach — Taobao provides livestream and content tools, recommendation distribution and marketplace access to creators. | ← Partner · Content / Engagement — Creators supply content and engagement that make Taobao's marketplace more immersive and increase time, discovery and transaction opportunities.

Explanation: Taobao governs Merchant and creator participation through product rules, intellectual-property enforcement, content rules, reviews, rankings and platform controls.
Taobao grows engagement through search, personalized feeds, livestreaming, short-form video, shopping festivals, loyalty and ecosystem cross-promotion.
Taobao operates search and recommendations, content distribution, Seller tools, marketing products, checkout, trust systems and creator-commerce infrastructure.
The Taobao app's traffic, product catalog, transaction history, recommendation systems, Merchant network and content-commerce infrastructure are core resources.
Consumers use Taobao to search, browse, watch, interact and purchase across a large mix of marketplace and Alibaba-ecosystem commerce experiences.
Shoppers want to find products that match needs, tastes and budgets and increasingly discover them through content as well as search.
Taobao combines broad assortment with personalized recommendations, livestreaming, short video, merchant interaction and promotional pricing.
Huge product variety can create choice overload, quality uncertainty, promotional complexity and difficulty distinguishing credible offers.
Shoppers select products and complete the marketplace order and payment through Taobao's commerce flow.

Explanation: Participation depends on account access, payment capability, geography, product restrictions and fraud or abuse controls.
The Taobao app is the top-level traffic funnel for product search, recommendations, livestreams, short-form video and connected Alibaba commerce channels.
Shoppers search, watch, compare, follow, chat, order, pay, review and interact with Merchants and KOLs.
Shoppers contribute purchasing power, attention, preferences, search behavior, engagement and review data.
Merchants are the supply side of the Taobao marketplace: independent sellers and businesses that create storefronts, product listings and fulfillment offers for consumer demand.
Merchants want to convert inventory, brand and product ideas into traffic, orders and repeat customer relationships.
Taobao provides access to large consumer demand plus search, recommendations, advertising, content-commerce and merchant operating tools.
Merchants compete for ranking, traffic, conversion and creator attention while managing fees, promotions, returns and platform rules.
Merchants supply product listings, commercial terms and the physical or digital product ultimately purchased by Shoppers.
Transaction Flows: → Owner · Listing / Fees — Merchants contribute product listings and purchase applicable marketing, software or other marketplace services. | ← Owner · Traffic / Payout — Taobao directs consumer traffic to Merchant supply and coordinates order proceeds through the platform transaction. | ← Consumer · Demand / Review — Shopper purchases, messages and reviews provide demand and reputation signals directly relevant to the Merchant. | → Consumer · Product — The Merchant ultimately supplies the purchased product to the Shopper. | → Partner · Products / Campaign — Merchants make products, campaign opportunities and commercial context available for creator-led promotion. | ← Partner · Traffic / Sales — Creators return attention, traffic and commerce demand to the Merchant's products and storefront.

Explanation: Merchants must satisfy identity, product, intellectual-property, quality and marketplace conduct requirements.
Merchants operate through Taobao seller tools, storefront systems, marketing products, customer-service tools and supported integrations.
Merchants create listings and content, manage inventory and pricing, advertise, collaborate with creators, fulfill orders and handle service.
Merchants contribute products, stock, pricing, product data, photos, brand assets, promotional material and fulfillment capacity.
KOLs and livestreamers are the Partner role because they complement Merchant supply with discovery, explanation, entertainment and social proof without being the underlying Seller of the product.
Creators turn Merchant products into engaging content that helps Shoppers understand, compare and desire products.
KOLs can build audiences and monetize influence through product collaborations and commerce activity.
Creators depend on audience trust, platform visibility, product quality and campaign performance and can suffer from misleading or poor-fit promotions.
Merchants make products and campaigns available to creators; creators return livestreams, recommendations and attention that can produce sales.

Explanation: Creators operate under content, commerce, advertising and platform rules and depend on reputation and audience response.
Creators reach Shoppers through Taobao Live, short-form video and other content surfaces integrated into the Taobao shopping journey.
Creators select products, host livestreams, make recommendations, interact with audiences and convert product information into shopping content.
Creators contribute followers, presentation skill, reputation, content production and product-selection expertise.
